cards.text: It's the eighth month of the second year of Darius, king of Persia (Ezra 4:24). The word of the LORD comes to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo. That's a full name AND a family tree, friend. My whole name is five letters carved into a handle.

cards.question: Before anything else, the LORD tells Zechariah how He felt about the people's fathers. True or false: He was very pleased with them.

cards.text: So Zechariah gets a message for the people from the LORD of Hosts, short enough to fit on the back of a takeout menu. I would know. I once wrote my whole goodbye on one.

cards.question: The LORD's message to the people starts with "Return to Me." If they do, what does He promise?
Then the LORD gives the people a warning: Do not be like your ___.

cards.text: The former prophets brought the fathers a message from the LORD of Hosts: 'Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.' One line, friend. My oven manual is FORTY pages.

cards.question: The former prophets told the fathers to turn from their evil ways and deeds. How did the fathers respond?
True or false: when the fathers ignored the former prophets, the LORD says they weren't paying attention to Him.

cards.text: Delivered. Read. NOTHING. They left the LORD of Hosts on read! Then God asks two questions and just lets them sit: 'Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?'

cards.question: God has asked where the fathers are now and whether the prophets live forever. Then He asks what overtook the fathers. What was it?
True or false: when the LORD's words caught up with the fathers, they still refused to repent.
The fathers said the LORD of Hosts did to them just what He purposed, according to their ways and ___.

cards.text: No excuses. No 'my phone died.' They owned it. And the LORD's offer to the people still stands: return to Him, and He will return to them.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 4 quotes "Return to Me.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The opening card has 4 sentences: the date line, the word of the LORD line, 'That's a full name AND a family tree, friend.' and 'My whole name is five letters carved into a handle.' It also never says who the message is for (the people), so the baker doesn't know who is being spoken to.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on.

findings.problem: The story card has 3 sentences: 'So Zechariah gets a message...', 'I would know.' and 'I once wrote my whole goodbye on one.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The story card has 3 sentences: the former prophets' quote, 'One line, friend.' and 'My oven manual is FORTY pages.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The story card runs about 5 sentences: 'Delivered.', 'Read.', 'NOTHING.', 'They left the LORD of Hosts on read!' and the line with God's two questions. It also carries two beats, a reaction to verse 4 and the questions in verse 5.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card says God 'asks what overtook the fathers.' In verse 6, God doesn't ask what overtook them. He asks whether His words and statutes overtook them ('But did not My words and My statutes... overtake your fathers?'). The retelling turns a rhetorical question into an open question, which the text shows is wrong.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The last card recaps what was already told and asked. Cards 11 and 12 already covered the fathers repenting, and card 4 covered the 'return to Me' offer from verse 3. It moves nothing forward. It also adds that the offer 'still stands,' which the text doesn't say. The card also has 4 sentences: 'No excuses.', 'No 'my phone died.'', 'They owned it.' and the closing line.
Beyond the recap problem, the card is too long: 4 sentences ('No excuses.', 'No 'my phone died.'', 'They owned it.' and the closing line).

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
